intent: Compact read-only status or category pill set by the system.
useWhen: Which mark: Badge is status the system sets (tone icon and word, subtle fill, 4px corner). If it is a number, it is never a Badge.
Status badges on table rows or cards
Category markers set by the system (user-managed labels use Tag)
doNotUseWhen: Money or metric changes — use Delta
Labels the user applies, removes, or selects — use Tag

appearance.note: soft is the subtle look (default) for status in tables and lists. solid fills use the tone's fg ink token for the one mark that must stand out. outline is a hairline.

tone.note: brand is an alias of primary. highlight is a gold marker, not a warning.

size.note: Heights sm 20 (space-5) and md 24 (space-6) share a row with Count; lg 28. No border, so the height is exact. Radius --radius-sm.

icon.note: Leading tone icon, aria-hidden; the word carries the meaning. Suggested: success CircleCheck (Paid), danger CircleX (Overdue), warning TriangleAlert (Due soon), info Info (Sent) or Clock (Invited), neutral Circle (Draft). Leave it off for plain role labels (Admin, Member).

onRemove.note: used when removable. Kept for dismissible filters; prefer kit Tag for user-removable labels

requirements: The tone icon is aria-hidden and never the only signal; the word says the status
disabled sets aria-disabled and prevents interaction
When removable, the X control is a button with aria-label Remove {children}
If removable and disabled, the remove control does not fire
Remove control shows a focus-visible ring using --border-focus
built-in labels (remove) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not invent a local Badge; for user-managed labels use kit Tag
Do not put numbers or money changes in a Badge — use Count or Delta
Do not use Badge as a button except the remove control
snippet:
<Badge appearance="soft" tone="success" size="md">Active</Badge>
<Badge tone="danger" size="sm" icon="CircleX">Overdue</Badge>
